_comment: Branch protection profile for `main`. Apply with: gh api -X PUT repos/:owner/:repo/branches/main/protection --input .github/branch-protection.json. See annuity_model/docs/CHANGELOG.md (Wave 7) for the rationale and the second-CODEOWNER upgrade path. Keep the contexts list in lockstep with the job names in .github/workflows/ -- if you rename a job here, rename it there in the same PR, otherwise PRs will hang forever waiting on a status that never reports.
